title: Write prompts that explicitly cover all facets of the scene (subjects, actions…
content: Write prompts that explicitly cover all facets of the scene (subjects, actions, environment, continuity details) because Seedance 2.0’s strong prompt adherence will expose any missing details as scene breakers.
tips: Write prompts that explicitly cover all facets of the scene (subjects, actions, environment, continuity details) because Seedance 2.0’s strong prompt adherence will expose any missing details as scene breakers.

es.content: Escribe prompts que cubran explícitamente todos los aspectos de la escena (sujetos, acciones, entorno, detalles de continuidad) porque la fuerte adherencia a los prompts de Seedance 2.0 expondrá cualquier detalle faltante como rupturas de escena.

fr.content: Rédigez des prompts qui couvrent explicitement tous les aspects de la scène (sujets, actions, environnement, détails de continuité) car la forte adhérence aux prompts de Seedance 2.0 mettra en évidence tout détail manquant en tant qu'éléments perturbateurs de la scène.

ja.content: シードンス2.0の強力なプロンプト遵守により、欠けている詳細がシーンブレーカーとして露呈するため、シーンのすべての側面（被写体、アクション、環境、連続性の詳細）を明確にカバーするプロンプトを書いてください。

ko.content: Seedance 2.0의 강력한 프롬프트 준수 기능은 누락된 세부 사항을 장면 파괴자로 드러낼 것이기 때문에, 장면의 모든 측면(주제, 행동, 환경, 연속성 세부 사항)을 명확하게 다루는 프롬프트를 작성하세요.

pt.content: Escreva prompts que cubram explicitamente todos os aspectos da cena (sujeitos, ações, ambiente, detalhes de continuidade), porque a forte aderência a prompts do Seedance 2.0 irá expor quaisquer detalhes ausentes como rupturas de cena.

zh.content: 编写提示时要明确涵盖场景的各个方面（主体、动作、环境、连续性细节），因为Seedance 2.0对提示的强大遵循能力会将任何缺失的细节暴露为场景破坏者。
